## Return to the PC’s HDMI input

Open **Settings → Controls → TV → Find HDMI inputs** while the TV is on and select the PC’s port. Canapey can then wake the TV and return to that input, even after someone has used a console. This works with manual wake and with automatic wake when enabled. Existing pairings keep the current input until you choose a port.

LG webOS, Sony BRAVIA IP Control and Roku TVs can report their HDMI inputs. Some Philips jointSPACE v6 models offer candidate ports to test. Samsung Tizen retains its power controls.

## Type in library search from an iPhone

Focus **Library → Search the library** while connected with Apple TV Remote in Control Center. The paired iPhone can enter, replace and clear text, including accents and emoji. Leaving the field closes the text session. This first version covers the library search field.

## Under the hood

Updated Vue, Tauri, Vite, TypeScript and the Rust libraries used for local TV networking and iPhone pairing. Automated Companion tests cover encrypted keyboard input. Physical iPhone discovery, the native iOS keyboard and switching sources on real TVs still need hardware testing.

Windows x64 experimental prerelease. Existing updater-enabled installations can use the built-in updater. For manual installation, download the setup executable below. The Tauri updater verifies its signature. The installer has no Windows Authenticode signature.
